title: Cartesian structure on fppf sheaves over an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $B$ an algebraic space over $S$, regarded as its fppf sheaf of sets [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Equip the category of fppf sheaves over $B$ with the cartesian monoidal structure whose unit is $\mathrm{id}_B$ and whose product of $F\to B$ and $H\to B$ is the sheaf fibre product $F\times_B H$. Use the pullback projections and universal property for its structural maps. This is the canonical pullback construction on an over-category; its restriction to algebraic spaces uses the sheaf fibre products of [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers].
